svg.title: Private serverless relational topology
svg.desc: Topology showing an application network, private endpoint, Azure SQL logical server, General Purpose serverless database, and monitoring workspace.

g.aria-label: private SQL connection: application to private-endpoint
private link resolution: private-endpoint to logical-server
serverless service objective: logical-server to database

svg.text: The line-of-business application uses private connectivity to a serverless database within a governed logical-server boundary.
